events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Jack Finley scored his first NHL goal early in the third period to break a tie and the Tampa Bay Lightning held on to beat the Florida Panthers 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Finley scores 1st NHL goal to help the Lightning beat the Panthers 3-1

headlines.description: — Minnesota backup Jesper Wallstedt made 28 saves for his second straight shutout and Wild beat the Anaheim Ducks 2-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jesper Wallstedt makes 28 saves for 2nd straight shutout, Wild beat Ducks 2-0

headlines.description: — Jeremy Swayman stopped 26 shots for his fifth consecutive victory and the Boston Bruins overcame the loss of defenseman Charlie McAvoy to a mouth injury to beat the Montreal Canadiens 3-2 on Saturday night in a heated game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Swayman stops 28 shots to help the Bruins beat the Canadiens 3-2 in a heated game

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Anton Forsberg made 17 saves in his Ottawa return for his first shutout of the season, Alex Laferriere scored in the first period and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Senators 1-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg makes 17 saves in his Ottawa return, the Kings beat the Senators 1-0

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Mattias Samuelsson scored at 1:05 of overtime as Buffalo rallied from a three-goal deficit to snap a five-game losing streak with a 5-4 win over Detroit on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuelsson's OT goal lifts Sabres past Red Wings, 5-4, for first road win of season

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Luke Hughes had a goal and assist and Simon Nemec had the shootout winner as the New Jersey Devils beat the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luke Hughes fills brother Jack’s void as Devils edge Capitals in 3-2 shootout

headlines.description: — Leon Draisaitl scored 19 seconds into overtime to give the Edmonton Oilers a 4-3 win against the Carolina Hurricanes on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Draisaitl scores in OT to give Oilers 4-3 win against Hurricanes

events.name: New York Rangers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — J.T. Miller and Vincent Trocheck scored in the shootout to give the New York Rangers their NHL-leading ninth road win, 2–1 over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers beat Blue Jackets 2-1 in shootout for NHL-leading 9th road win

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Colton Dach scored the tiebreaking goal late in the third period, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dach scores late in 3rd period to lead Blackhawks to 3-2 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Braeden Bowman scored his first NHL goal and got his first assist, and the Vegas Golden Knights snapped a four-game losing streak with a 4-1 win over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bowman scores his first NHL goal, sparks Golden Knights to 4-1 win over Blues

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson’s natural hat trick gave him consecutive multigoal games, and the Dallas Stars beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Saturday night for their fifth victory in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson's natural hat trick leads Stars past Flyers 5-1

headlines.description: — Gabriel Vilardi scored the lone goal in a shootout to give the Winnipeg Jets a 4-3 victory over the Calgary Flames on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vilardi scores lone shootout goal to lift the Jets past the Flames, 4-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Philipp Grubauer stopped all 19 shots he faced in relief of injured Matt Murray, and the Seattle Kraken got two goals from Jaden Schwartz to help beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grubauer stops all 19 shots in relief as the Kraken beat the Sharks 4-1
